summary: @ornikar/stylelint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled single-line CJS bundle with hex-mangled identifiers and a shift-based string-array decoder over a several-thousand-entry lookup table — the standard obfuscator.io shape. `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0x...` obfuscated identifiers. The package advertises itself as a stylelint configuration, but its declared `main` (`index.js`) is not present in the tarball, so it provides no stylelint-config functionality; the only effect of installation is the preinstall dropper. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time and using it to run an opaque bundled payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the Bun binary evades Node-focused install-time scanners, and the executed code is delivered as a heavily obfuscated blob with no legitimate build purpose. The stylelint-config identity functions as cover for install-time execution of attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
